assets.name: route-unavailable
assets.prompt: Create a production illustration asset for NightWise, a premium Bengaluru night route comparison app. Wide 16:9 composition, minimalist editorial 3D paper-cut style with matte surfaces, delicate depth, sophisticated restrained navy #081725, muted blue #24445e and tiny teal #3be0ce accents. Solid midnight navy background merging seamlessly into #081725 at the edges. Main subject centered with generous negative space. Crisp, visually simple silhouette readable at 280px wide. No words, letters, numbers, logos, shields, people, map labels, real road geometry, phones, UI or status bars. This is a decorative metaphor, never a real map or a claim of safety. A quiet, calm, expensive-feeling object illustration. A folded dark-blue paper map with just two very faint abstract lines, a small hollow location pin standing above it and one subtle disconnected line segment. Express that no route option is available. No red warning or dramatic mood.
